title: Rayfield Teleport Hub
features:
🌀 Rayfield Teleport Hub

This script is an advanced Rayfield UI tool for Roblox that provides two main teleport systems:

🔹 Player Teleport

Enter a player’s username, display name, or short form.

Instantly teleport behind the selected player.

Optionally enable loop mode to stay locked behind them as they move.

Disables teleporting to players with ForceFields or 0 HP.

When loop mode ends, you return to your original position.

🔹 Team Teleport

Enter a team name (case-insensitive).

Enables loop teleportation that keeps you behind the first valid member of that team.

If no valid team member is found, teleportation pauses until one becomes available.

When the loop ends, you also return to your original position.

⚙️ Features

✅ Smooth Rayfield UI with tabs for Player and Team teleports

✅ Smart filtering for ForceFields and dead players

✅ Position memory (teleports you back after loop toggle off)

✅ AI-style structure, optimized for executors (not Studio only)
